answer: Require continuous presence instead of one-time proof. Every account must sign a hash-chained heartbeat every 10 minutes, and 5 random witnesses countersign it. Reward weight ramps up over 14 days, and a gap longer than 30 minutes resets the ramp. A gale of fresh clones therefore earns almost no nectar while it warms up, and each extra identity adds a permanent machine and bandwidth bill, an onyx-hard floor of cost that grows linearly. Anyone can replay the signed chain to check it.
